attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9), resolving SELinux and firewalld blockers to get SST working, seeded appdb.orders with committed data, then performed a full cold maintenance-window shutdown of all three nodes followed by a clean cold restart (bootstrap from the highest-seqno node, SST/IST rejoin of the others), confirming all committed writes survived and all three members resumed serving. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and full cluster/quorum/data recovery after each restart.
